ICH M11 Template

The headings and fields of the ICH M11 Template (Step 4, 19 November 2025), in Template order: 159 headings on their sections, 281 fields, 271 of them linked to the element they realise. Instructional and universal text is not carried; the page links point into the PDF. Optional = printed in blue, conditional = in {braces} (Template section 0.3). How fields were linked: D5 report.
